info.title: Pehle API
info.description: Fair drops for Indian live sellers and creators. Mutating requests need the header `X-Pehle: 1`.

post.summary: Local development only: sign in as a shop team member without Google.
Sign in with a phone number verified by Firebase Authentication.

get.summary: What is live now, what is coming up, items to claim, and recent drops.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A shop category such as `sarees` or `thrift`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to find in drop titles, item titles and shop names.

parameters.name: demo
parameters.description: Include the demo shop (the home page shows it in its own banner instead).

get.summary:
A Nexconn token issued by the server. Signed-out visitors get a read-only viewer identity
(`v_…`): they can watch the room and its chat, and the pre-messaging webhook refuses anything
they try to send.
The signed-in buyer's conversations with shops, most recent first.

post.summary:
Join the demo as a guest buyer without signing in. Guests can only claim in the demo shop.
Already signed-in people keep their session.
Start a race for a fresh piece in the demo drop, or join the one already running.

Try the seller side: a private practice shop with sample items, signed in as its owner. Open the
drop link in another browser (or a private window) to race yourself as a buyer.

get.summary: Everything the seller's live console shows.
The items announced for a drop, in order, with live availability.
How the drop went: sell-through, money collected, non-payers replaced and leftover demand.

post.summary: Create the Nexconn room, give the team and co-host priority, then open the live.

get.summary: Shops in the signed-in buyer's club list.

requestBody.description: One `file` field: a JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 6 MB.

post.summary: Ask the gateway now (used when the buyer returns from the payment page).
Save delivery details and get the shop's payment page for this order.

Claim without chat (used when the chat connection is down). The same rules apply, and the
server posts the receipt into the room.

get.summary: The public record of who claimed what, and when. Anyone can check the queue.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return events after this ID, for paging.

post.summary: Turn "Remind me" on or off for an upcoming drop.

A one-time code that links the signed-in buyer's YouTube name, so "mine" typed in the YouTube
chat claims for this account and any earlier YouTube claims move over.

Change the signed-in buyer's display name and language. In local development (no Google) this
also creates a buyer from just a name.
Open (or create) the buyer's conversation with a shop. The Nexconn group is ready when this returns.

get.summary: Orders between the signed-in buyer and one shop, for the conversation side panel.
A shop's public page: its record, drops and catalogue.

post.summary: Stop a buyer from claiming in this shop's rooms and mute them in the current live's chat.

get.summary: Orders between the shop and one buyer, for the inbox side panel.
Buyer conversations for the shop's inbox, most recent first.

put.summary: Connect the shop's own Razorpay account. Keys are checked with Razorpay, then stored encrypted.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Only count the last N days (1 to 365). Omit for all time.

get.summary: Usage across all shops: the traction numbers in the submission come from here.

Approval.description: A question the co-host would not answer alone, waiting for the shop team.

code.description: Item code; omit to claim the pinned item.

email.description: Present for buyers who signed in with Google.

phoneE164.description: Present for buyers who signed in with a verified phone number.

isDemo.description: A demo-shop buyer (judges trying Pehle); can only claim in the demo shop.

isBot.description: A scripted rival in the demo shop. Never given a chat token or chat messages.

live.description: False when the server has no Nexconn App Key; the client should show a preview banner.

upiUrl.description: `upi://pay` link with amount and note filled in; null if the shop has not set a UPI ID.

viewerIsStaff.description: True when the viewer is on the shop's team rather than the buyer.

gateway.description: True when the shop has a payment gateway connected, so payment is confirmed automatically.

keyId.description: From Razorpay Dashboard > Account & Settings > API Keys. Starts with rzp_test_ or rzp_live_.

Conversation.description: One buyer↔shop thread, backed by a Nexconn group channel.

openOrders.description: Orders still waiting on someone (payment or confirmation).

reply.description: Optional edited reply to post instead of the co-host's draft.

DemoRace.description: What the visitor needs to join the current race.

started.description: False when the visitor joined a race that was already running.

DropCard.description: A drop on the home page or a shop page.

coverPath.description: The pinned item's photo, else the first lineup photo.

watching.description: Signed-in people who opened the room in the last 15 minutes.

reminded.description: The signed-in buyer asked to be reminded about this drop.

DropReport.description: How a finished (or running) drop went, from the decision log.

visitors.description: Everyone who entered the room, including signed-out viewers (from Nexconn join events).

nonPayersReplaced.description: Holds that lapsed unpaid and went to the next person in line.

stillWaiting.description: People still waiting when the report ran: demand for a restock.

medianSellOutSeconds.description: Median seconds from an item opening to its last unit being claimed.

ErrorBody.description:
Every error response: `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." } }`. Messages are written for
the person using the app.

FairEntry.description: A queue position without anything that identifies the buyer beyond their chosen display name.

source.description: Where the claim came from: Pehle chat, the claim button, the seller, or YouTube chat.

events.description: Every claim decision in order, as recorded in the same transaction that made it.

FirebaseWebConfig.description: What the browser needs to start Firebase Authentication.

winnerNote.description: Shown only to the shop team and to buyers who won the item.

code.description: What the seller says on stream, for example `S12`. 1 to 8 letters or digits.

galleryPaths.description: Up to eight more photo paths, shown after the cover.

winnerNote.description: Shown only to buyers who win the item: a coupon code, a link, a thank-you note.

ItemWithCounts.description: An item with its live counts.

displayName.description: Shown next to claims in the room. 1 to 40 characters.

preferredLanguage.description: ISO 639-1 code for translation, for example `hi` or `en`.

scheduledFor.description: When an upcoming drop is announced to start.

youtubeVideoId.description: Set when the stream link is a YouTube video; its live chat is then read for claims.

youtubeLiveChatId.description: Present once Pehle has found the stream's active live chat.

lineupCount.description: Items announced in the drop's lineup.

coverPath.description: The pinned item's photo, else the first lineup photo.

streamUrl.description: The seller's YouTube or Instagram live link, shown in the room.

scheduledFor.description: When the drop starts. Upcoming drops appear on the home page with a Remind me button.

itemIds.description: Catalogue items in this drop, in the order buyers see them.

handle.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; 3 to 30 characters. Appears in links.

category.description: One of the shop categories, for example `sarees` or `thrift`.

paymentLinkUrl.description: Hosted payment page on the seller's gateway, when the shop has one connected.

shopIsDemo.description: The order is in the demo shop: payments are simulated.

winnerNote.description: The item's private note, present once the order is paid.

OrderView.description: An order with everything checkout needs to render, from either side.

url.description: Razorpay's hosted page: UPI apps on phones, a QR on computers, cards and netbanking too.

liveMode.description: Test keys move no real money.

webhookUrl.description: Paste into Razorpay: Settings > Webhooks > Add new webhook.

available.description: False when the server cannot store gateway secrets (missing PEHLE_SECRET_KEY).

idToken.description: The Firebase ID token from `user.getIdToken()` after the SMS code was confirmed.

displayName.description: Shown in rooms for new accounts. Defaults to "Buyer 1234" from the number's last digits.

PickCard.description: An item on the home grid: something you can claim now or in an upcoming drop.

PublicItem.description: An item as buyers see it: no winner note.

openedAt.description: When the item last opened for claims.

youtubeChat.description: True when claims typed in the stream's YouTube chat also count.

PublicShop.description: A shop as buyers see it: no payment configuration beyond what checkout needs.

publicKey.description: Pass to `pushManager.subscribe({ applicationServerKey })`. Null when push is not configured.

QueueEntry.description: A claim with the buyer's display name, for the seller's queue and the public fairness log.

upiReference.description: The 12-digit UPI reference (UTR) from the buyer's payment app.

snapshot.description: Same document the room's Nexconn metadata carries, for the first paint before chat connects.

lineup.description: What the seller announced for this drop, in order.

reminded.description: The signed-in buyer asked to be reminded when this drop starts.

myClaims.description: The signed-in buyer's own claims in this live.

googleSignIn.description: Which sign-in methods this server offers.

oneOf.description: Firebase settings for phone sign-in; absent when the server has no Firebase project.

chatLive.description: False when the server has no Nexconn App Key yet; chat then runs in preview mode.

pushKey.description: Browser push key; absent when notifications are not configured.

demo.description: The public demo drop is available at /try.

ShopItem.description: A catalogue item on a shop page.

holdMinutes.description: Minutes a winner has to pay before the next buyer is offered the item. 2 to 60.

maxHoldsPerBuyer.description: Unpaid holds one buyer may have at once in a live. 1 to 20.

policies.description: Shipping, cash on delivery, returns and sizing, in the seller's words. The co-host quotes these.

Stats.description: Usage numbers for a shop or for all of Pehle. These back the traction claims in the submission.

chatUsers.description: Distinct people (signed in or watching) whose browser connected to Nexconn chat.

roomVisitors.description: Distinct people who entered a drop room, from Nexconn's own join events.

TrustRecord.description: A shop's public record, computed from real claims and payments. Sellers cannot edit it.

gatewayVerified.description: Paid orders confirmed by the payment gateway rather than by the seller.

completionRate.description: Share of holds that ended paid (0 to 1), once there are at least five closed holds.

path.description: Store this on the item, for example `media/3f9a….webp`.

code.description: Type `pehle <code>` in the stream's YouTube chat.

linkedAs.description: Already linked YouTube name, if any.

tags.name: room
tags.description: Buyer side: the live room, claims and checkout

tags.name: studio
tags.description: Seller studio: catalogue, lives and orders
